0.6.0.reason: Keys of open objects (attributes, data, GeoJSON foreign members) are limited to 128 characters; previously key length was unbounded.
Vocabularies must not contain duplicate labels.
An empty 'segments' array no longer satisfies the requirement for 'text' or 'segments'.
A page number may appear only once per page-size entry.
Empty multi_polygon arrays are no longer valid geometry.
'unit' is required whenever any block carries box, polygon or multi_polygon geometry.
Geometric locations now use the shared geometry definitions, which forbid negative coordinates and dimensions.
Requires 'multi_polygon' when block_type is 'multi_polygon'; 0.5.0 did not allow that block_type, so no 0.5.0 data is affected.
New 'span' location; its type const is disjoint from the existing branches, so no 0.5.0 data is affected.
'unit' is required whenever any entity has a geometric ('block') location.
Unit limits for the new multi_polygon geometry; 0.5.0 locations could not contain multi_polygon.
New multi_polygon geometry; 0.5.0 objects could not contain multi_polygon, so no 0.5.0 data is affected.
An empty 'objects' array now requires 'vocabulary', 'vocabulary_url' or 'producer', consistent with classification and entity-extraction.
Unit limits for the new multi_polygon geometry; 0.5.0 objects could not contain multi_polygon.
statistic 'quantile' requires quantile_level, and quantile_level is only allowed with statistic 'quantile'.
Foreign members on the Feature are capped (maxProperties 32).
Foreign members on geometry objects are capped (maxProperties 16).
Positions enforce WGS 84 ranges: longitude [-180, 180], latitude [-90, 90].
Positions accept only [longitude, latitude, altitude?]; this replaces the generic numeric 'items' with prefixItems.
Polygons must contain at least one linear ring, as RFC 7946 requires.
A bbox must have exactly 4 (2D) or 6 (3D) values, as RFC 7946 requires; 5 was previously accepted.
'producer' is now a first-class string field, as in every other schema; previously it was any foreign member.
